Safety & Moderation

SupportCommunity GuidelinesPrivacyDelete Content

Public expression needs clear boundaries and responsive moderation.

Report content

Use the Report action on a public post or reply and select the closest reason. Reports enter a private review queue. You can also email typhoon.lab.app@gmail.com.

How we respond

We prioritize credible threats, child safety, sexual exploitation, severe harassment, exposed personal information, and content encouraging imminent self-harm. We aim to review urgent safety reports within 24 hours and other reports within 3 business days. These are goals rather than guarantees.

Possible actions

We may leave content visible, hide or delete it, preserve it for safety or legal reasons, restrict access, or refer a matter to an appropriate authority when reasonably necessary.

Immediate danger

Unsend is not continuously monitored and cannot provide emergency assistance. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. In the United States and its territories, call or text 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.

Contact
